segs.t: Guys, if you're in an e-com and you're still stuck doing fashion,
dobshipping or whatsoever, you literally have a skill issue.
And the reason why I say this is because you have not learned any real skill in order to go ahead and acquire customers.
You've been ripping creatives your whole life.
You've been putting 50% offers onto them and just hoping that people buy.
You do not understand how front-end acquisition works.
How to create ads that are literally winning ads in order to convert customers.
Get customers to whip out their credit cards and end up paying on your store.
You do not understand that.
Let alone having a back-end that literally can go against disputes,
go against supply chain being run out of inventory and all that type of stuff.
You've not learned that and it's not your fault.
You've been taught something that is, yes, a good skill to get started with,
but if you want to become a real business owner and have a real sustainable business,
you need to start an MRR brand.
And MRR means monthly recurring revenue.
Having that come into your brand every single day,
making you not rely on Facebook ads,
is going to be a complete game changer for you.
And it's going to also teach you the exact real life skills that you need,
how to do copywriting, how to create ads that convert,
how to make sure that you have enough inventory,
how to make sure that your team and finances are in check.
All of these things are being learned and taught inside of MRR Mastery.
If you're not an MRR Mastery today and you want to learn more,
make sure to meet MRR and I'll see if you're a fit.
